spf_all_resolution_is_ok.resultText: All terms that need DNS (a, mx, exists, include, redirect) resolve, and every include and redirect target has a valid SPF record.
spf_all_resolution_is_ok.title: Mechanism resolution check

spf_no_duplicate_include_found.description: Including the same domain twice — in two include: terms, or in include: and redirect= — spends another of the 10 allowed DNS lookups without adding any sender.
spf_no_duplicate_include_found.fix: Remove duplicate include: terms: each extra copy spends another DNS lookup and adds no sender. If the duplicate is inside a provider's record you include, the provider already covers it, so remove your own include — unless the outer include is the provider's corporate or umbrella record (for example include:salesforce.com) that authorizes more than you use: then keep the include the provider documents for customers (include:_spf.salesforce.com) and remove the umbrella one. If the provider's record lists the same domain twice, only the provider can fix that.

spf_record_termination_is_ok.title: SPF record termination check

spf_syntax_is_ok.description: Any syntax error in the SPF record makes receivers return permerror for the whole record (RFC 7208 §4.6): none of its terms is evaluated, so SPF can never pass and DMARC cannot align on SPF. Terms that are valid but ignored by receivers — usually typos such as include= instead of include: — are reported as warnings.
spf_syntax_is_ok.fix: Fix or remove the invalid term. Mechanisms are all, include, a, mx, ptr (avoid it), ip4, ip6 and exists, written with a colon (include:example.com); redirect= and exp= are modifiers and may each appear only once — delete an extra copy. Common typos: ipv4:/ipv6: instead of ip4:/ip6:, include= instead of include:, text glued to all. Other name=value terms are unknown modifiers: receivers ignore them, so they are not errors.
spf_syntax_is_ok.resultText: The SPF record has syntax errors, or terms that receivers ignore.
spf_syntax_is_ok.title: SPF record syntax check
spf_syntax_is_ok.value: "ip4=50.31.98.110": unknown modifier, so receivers ignore this term (did you mean ip4:50.31.98.110?)
